newsitem.title: USA: US Feb stock funds net new cash flow $19.5 bln-ICI.
newsitem.headline: US Feb stock funds net new cash flow $19.5 bln-ICI.

text.p: Net U.S. stock mutual fund flows were estimated at $19.5 billion in February, the Investment Company Institute said Thursday.
The ICI said in a statement stock mutual fund estimates in January were revised down to $29.1 billion from $29.4 billion.
ICI said bond and income flows were $2 billion in February compared with a revised $3.4 billion in January. January bond and income flows were previously reported at $2.9 billion.

ICI said net new cash flow to long-term mutual funds was estimated at $21.5 billion last month, compared with revised actual flows of $32.5 billion in January that were previously reported as $32.3 billion. Long-term mutual funds include stock, bond and income.
ICI said its monthly estimates are based on a survey of long-term funds that account for about 97 percent of long-term mutual fund assets.
Revisions to net new cash flows are provided to account for errors in new sales and redemption data reported to the institute, ICI said.
